quest.guhs.weeb.zwaai.e: You too, guh-chan? Wave us off! We'll bring something back for you. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.weeb.zwaai.n: Ittekimasu, senpai! We're off to Japan. Don't touch the figurines.
quest.guhs.weeb.cadeau: You get a present from Japan: %s
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.ja: A double? Sugoi. Swapping is collecting too, senpai.
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.hier: Here, guh-chan. You didn't have this one yet. Kawaii!
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.enige: You only have one of those. That one's a keeper. Bring a double, nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.ruil.compleet: Your set is already complete, guh-chan. Sugoi! You can keep that double.
quest.guhs.weeb.compleet: Your whole set is complete. A true weeb. Wahoog, we're so proud!
gui.guhs.weeb.ballon: Evichonk and Nielschonk's balloon. Not real public transport, says Nielschonk.
gui.guhs.weeb.beschermd: Don't touch the Weeb House. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.figuurtjes: Don't touch. That's a limited edition.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.poster: It hangs exactly straight. Don't touch, senpai.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.dakimakura: A guh dakimakura. It's Nielschonk's. Don't sit on it.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.loket: Evichonk's mini counter. Stamps, an ink pad and a little stack of passports.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.nummerautomaat: Your number: 047. There are 46 guhs waiting ahead of you. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.loketbord.open: Counter open. Take a number. (Passports only at the Guh Town Hall.)
gui.guhs.weeb.klik.briefje: Gone to Japan for a bit. Back tomorrow. Don't touch the figurines. — E & N
gui.guhs.japan.lore: From Japan. A present from Evichonk and Nielschonk.
gui.guhs.japan.eten: From Japan. Yummy for you and for your guh. Itadakimasu!
structure.guhs.weebhuisje.tooltip: A guh-Japanese little house in Babbledale. Evichonk and Nielschonk live there. When they're home.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.1.1: Ohayo, guh-chan! Come in, shoes off. Kawaii little house, right?
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.1.2: Sugoi, a visitor! Want to see my figurines? Don't touch. That's a limited edition.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.1.3: Wait... Niels. It's cherry blossom season.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.2.1: Konnichiwa, guh-chan! Tea? It's real matcha. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.2.2: Have a seat, senpai. Not on the dakimakura. That one's mine.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.2.3: Wait... Evi. The new train line opens today. With a new Shinkansen.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.3.1: Ohayo! Take a number, guh-chan. Just kidding. The counter is closed today.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.3.2: Look, shelf three. All guh figurines. Kawaii, right? Don't touch.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.3.3: Wait... Niels. That one figurine comes out today. The limited edition.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.4.1: Konnichiwa, guh-chan. Smell that? Evi is making ramen. Sugoi.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.4.2: Itadakimasu! ...Hm. Tasty. But it's just not quite the real thing.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.5.1: Ohayo, guh-chan! Pretty, aren't they, our lanterns? Kawaii, nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.5.2: I hung them up myself, senpai. In timetable order.
quest.guhs.weeb.scene.5.3: Wait... Niels. The lantern festival is this weekend.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.1.n: By balloon. Again. That's not real public transport.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.1.e: I've got the passports! All aboard, Niels. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.2.n: A balloon doesn't even have a timetable. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.2.e: But it has a view! Ittekimasu, guh-chan!
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.3.n: No platform, no track, no conductor. Not real public transport.
quest.guhs.weeb.vertrek.3.e: It does fly to Japan. Come on, senpai!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.1.1: Tadaima! The Shinkansen was on time. To the second. It almost made me cry, nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.1.2: Here, guh-chan. A present from Japan. Arigato for waving us off!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.2.1: Tadaima! I collected seven stamps. Seven! Every station has its own stamp.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.2.2: And I got the window seat, senpai. Here, this is for you. Arigato!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.3.1: Tadaima! There was a long line at passport control. They waved me right through. A true pro, chonk.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.3.2: She knows every stamp by heart. Here, a little something from Japan. Kawaii, right?
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.4.1: Tadaima! Rode eleven trains. Zero minutes of delay. Sugoi.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.4.2: He filmed every train, guh-chan. Every one. Here, for you. Arigato!
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.5.1: Tadaima! My passport is stamped full. I'll make myself a new one tomorrow. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.weeb.terug.5.2: The balloon back had no timetable again. Oh well. Here, a present, senpai.
quest.guhs.dal.theeguh.1: Konnichiwa. Tea? Have a nice sit. The waterfall does the rest. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.dal.theeguh.2: Shh. Hear that? Babble, babble. Makes you all chonky.
quest.guhs.dal.theeguh.3: I've been sitting here all day. Tomorrow again. Wahoog, what a life.
